precision: bf16 mixed with FP32 coordinate output and quantization
token_format: one 12-bit FSQ code per real token, including punctuation
primary_metric: macro average of per-source mean molecule RMSD, no alignment
selection: Compare only final fixed-budget validation. Prefer baseline unless an alternative improves macro RMSD by >=2% for both seeds without >5% aggregate p95 or per-source regression. Compact is eligible within 1% macro RMSD on both seeds and 5% p95/per-source with >=20% faster steps. Pick lowest macro RMSD among qualifying alternatives; compact tradeoff only if no clear quality winner. This is a conservative engineering rule, not a novelty or significance claim. Mean bond and pair-distance errors must also stay within 5% on both seeds.
schedule: Matched full-run prefix: 1000 optimizer-step linear warmup, constant LR until 90% of full-run updates, then cosine; pilot has no artificial early decay.
